sources.title: What to do about a scam call, text or message
facts: The page advises users not to engage with suspicious contact
It explains reporting and protective actions
limitations: The page is general guidance, not incident verification
Reporting a message does not establish its origin

sources.title: Scam calls, texts and messages
facts: The page explains Ofcom's role alongside providers and government agencies
It links recognition, protection and reporting guidance
limitations: An overview does not validate a reported scam
Safety evidence is not service-coverage evidence

sources.title: Using your mobile abroad
sources.geography: United Kingdom mobile customers travelling abroad
facts: The page explains that roaming can create extra charges
Customers are advised to check their package or provider before travel
limitations: Roaming terms vary by provider and destination
Guidance does not prove local mobile coverage

sources.title: Money saving tips for phone, broadband and pay-TV
facts: The page provides cost-saving actions for phone, broadband and pay-TV
It directs consumers to contract, switching and tariff options
limitations: Potential savings depend on personal circumstances
Cost guidance does not prove service eligibility

sources.title: Switching landline provider
facts: The guide explains One Touch Switch for landline services
It covers switching bundles as well as standalone landlines
limitations: Switching procedure does not prove a provider serves an address
Individual charges and eligibility require provider confirmation
